cariboo.title: Loon Lake area evacuation order extends to nearly 1,500 properties due to Pear Lake fire
cariboo.description: The new properties under evacuation order include Loon Lake and properties on Highway 97 from Loon Lake Road to past Scottie Creek Road.

all.title: B.C. firefighters face critical days as dry fuels and winds increase fire risks
all.description: A cold front with gusty winds could bring extreme fire behaviour in areas where British Columbia communities are threatened by wildfires.
